official_access.access_mode: official GovInfo bulk XML, current XML file for each eCFR title
official_access.rule: Traverse the GovInfo bulk repository/listing and mirror XML by source path; do not scrape individual eCFR HTML pages.

structures: explicit MATH elements that mark MathType equation material
scope.original_representation: exact decoded source <MATH> XML block, including attributes and linked image references
exclusions: No reconstruction of image-backed equations in extracted stage
No automatic formalization of prose thresholds, tables, or verbal legal rules in this lane

snapshot_policy.rule: eCFR is a mutable current editorial compilation. Mirror the complete current XML set, record relative path, byte size and SHA-256 for each XML object, sort deterministically by path, and identify the acquisition as inventory-sha256:<digest>. A wall-clock date alone is insufficient.

license_policy.scope: U.S. Government corpus with third-party-content caveat
license_policy.rule: GovInfo states U.S. Government works are generally public domain under 17 U.S.C. 105, while Government publications may contain third-party copyrighted material. Publish Atlas occurrence metadata and permitted XML excerpts with provenance; do not mirror linked equation image bytes unless their rights are separately audited.

adapter.input: local mirror of official GovInfo eCFR XML files
validation: Preserve exact decoded source MATH XML as expression_original
Preserve title/section locator and document SHA-256 when available
Preserve linked graphic references without downloading their bytes
Never claim OCR or reconstruction in the extracted stage
